hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/seams/spend.py"; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; python3 -I "$f" pre-tool-use || true
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/seams/spend.py"; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; python3 -I "$f" subagent-stop || true
